law.catch_line: Certain provisions in Article 1 (§ 58.1-4000 et seq.) to apply, mutatis mutandis
law.text: Except as provided in this article, the provisions of Article 1 (§ 58.1-4000 et seq.) shall apply to sports betting under this article. The Board shall promulgate regulations to interpret and clarify the applicability of Article 1 to this article.
